title: Have to, don't have to, must, mustn't - Obligation and necessity

options.answer: You don't must smoke here.
You mustn't smoke here.
You haven't to smoke here.

explanation.en: Use 'mustn't' for prohibition. 'Don't must' and 'haven't to' are incorrect forms.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'mustn't' для запрета. 'Don't must' и 'haven't to' - неправильные формы.
explanation.uz: 'Mustn't' taqiq uchun ishlatiladi. 'Don't must' va 'haven't to' noto'g'ri shakllardir.

options.answer: I must to go now.
I have go now.
I have to go now.

explanation.en: 'Have to' expresses necessity and obligation. Don't add 'to' after 'must'.
explanation.ru: 'Have to' выражает необходимость и обязанность. Не добавляйте 'to' после 'must'.
explanation.uz: 'Have to' zarurat va majburiyatni bildiradi. 'Must'dan keyin 'to' qo'shmang.

options.answer: She doesn't have to work on Sunday.
She don't have to work on Sunday.
She hasn't to work on Sunday.

explanation.en: Use 'doesn't have to' with third person singular. 'Don't have to' is for other persons.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'doesn't have to' с третьим лицом единственного числа. 'Don't have to' для других лиц.
explanation.uz: Uchinchi shaxs birlik uchun 'doesn't have to' ishlatiladi. 'Don't have to' boshqa shaxslar uchun.

options.answer: We must be quiet in the library.
We have be quiet in the library.
We must to be quiet in the library.

explanation.en: 'Must' is followed directly by the base form of the verb without 'to'.
explanation.ru: После 'must' идет базовая форма глагола без 'to'.
explanation.uz: 'Must'dan keyin 'to' qo'shilmasdan fe'lning asosiy shakli keladi.

options.answer: Do you must wear a uniform?
Must you wear a uniform?
Do you have to wear a uniform?

explanation.en: Questions with 'have to' use 'do/does'. Questions with 'must' don't use 'do'.
explanation.ru: Вопросы с 'have to' используют 'do/does'. Вопросы с 'must' не используют 'do'.
explanation.uz: 'Have to' bilan savollarda 'do/does' ishlatiladi. 'Must' bilan savollarda 'do' ishlatilmaydi.

options.answer: Students mustn't use mobile phones during exams.
Students don't must use mobile phones during exams.
Students haven't to use mobile phones during exams.

explanation.en: 'Mustn't' expresses prohibition - something is not allowed.
explanation.ru: 'Mustn't' выражает запрет - что-то не разрешено.
explanation.uz: 'Mustn't' taqiqni bildiradi - biror narsa ruxsat etilmagan.

options.answer: You don't have to come if you don't want to.
You mustn't come if you don't want to.
You haven't come if you don't want to.

explanation.en: 'Don't have to' means it's not necessary. 'Mustn't' means it's forbidden.
explanation.ru: 'Don't have to' означает, что это не обязательно. 'Mustn't' означает, что это запрещено.
explanation.uz: 'Don't have to' majburiy emasligini bildiradi. 'Mustn't' taqiqlanganligini bildiradi.

options.answer: He musts finish his homework.
He must finish his homework.
He must to finish his homework.

explanation.en: 'Must' doesn't change form and is followed by the base verb without 'to'.
explanation.ru: 'Must' не изменяется по формам и за ним следует базовый глагол без 'to'.
explanation.uz: 'Must' shaklini o'zgartirmaydi va undan keyin 'to'siz asosiy fe'l keladi.

options.answer: Does she has to work late?
Does she have to work late?
Must she has to work late?

explanation.en: Questions with 'have to' use 'do/does' + subject + 'have to' + base verb.
explanation.ru: Вопросы с 'have to' используют 'do/does' + подлежащее + 'have to' + базовый глагол.
explanation.uz: 'Have to' bilan savollarda 'do/does' + ega + 'have to' + asosiy fe'l ishlatiladi.

options.answer: Children mustn't play with fire.
Children don't must play with fire.
Children haven't to play with fire.

explanation.en: Use 'mustn't' to express strong prohibition for safety rules.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'mustn't' для выражения строгого запрета в правилах безопасности.
explanation.uz: Xavfsizlik qoidalarida qat'iy taqiq uchun 'mustn't' ishlatiladi.

items.text:
School Rules and Regulations

Every student ___1___ follow the school rules to maintain a safe and positive learning environment. Students ___2___ arrive at school on time every day, and they ___3___ wear their school uniform properly. However, students ___4___ bring lunch from home if they prefer, as the school cafeteria is optional.

In the classroom, students ___5___ raise their hand before speaking and they ___6___ listen carefully when the teacher is explaining. Students ___7___ use their mobile phones during lessons as this disturbs other learners. They ___8___ keep their phones in their bags or lockers.

During examinations, students ___9___ cheat or help other students. This is strictly forbidden and can result in serious consequences. Students ___10___ bring any unauthorized materials into the exam room, including notes or electronic devices.

For homework, students ___11___ complete all assignments on time, but they ___12___ stay after school to finish them if they need extra help from teachers. The library is available for those who ___13___ work in a quiet environment.

Finally, all students ___14___ respect their teachers and classmates. They ___15___ use polite language and treat everyone with kindness and consideration.

explanation.en: This exercise demonstrates the use of 'must' for obligations and rules, 'mustn't' for prohibitions, 'have to' for external necessities, and 'don't have to' for things that are not necessary.
explanation.ru: Это упражнение демонстрирует использование 'must' для обязанностей и правил, 'mustn't' для запретов, 'have to' для внешних необходимостей и 'don't have to' для того, что не обязательно.
explanation.uz: Bu mashq majburiyat va qoidalar uchun 'must', taqiqlar uchun 'mustn't', tashqi zaruriyatlar uchun 'have to' va majburiy bo'lmagan narsalar uchun 'don't have to' ishlatishni ko'rsatadi.

items.text:
Living in a Shared Apartment

When you live with roommates, there are certain rules everyone ___1___ follow to maintain harmony. First, you ___2___ keep common areas clean and tidy. This means you ___3___ wash your dishes immediately after eating and you ___4___ leave dirty clothes in the living room.

Regarding noise, roommates ___5___ play loud music late at night because others need to sleep. However, you ___6___ be completely silent during the day as normal conversation and activities are acceptable. Everyone ___7___ respect each other's privacy and personal space.

For household expenses, each person ___8___ contribute their fair share for utilities and cleaning supplies. You ___9___ pay for your roommate's personal items, but shared expenses like electricity and internet ___10___ be split equally among everyone.

Guests are welcome, but roommates ___11___ inform others in advance when someone is coming to stay overnight. You ___12___ ask permission for short visits, but longer stays require discussion with all residents.

Finally, everyone ___13___ take turns with household chores like taking out the trash and cleaning the bathroom. Nobody ___14___ do everything alone, and everyone ___15___ participate in maintaining their shared home.

explanation.en: This passage shows how modals of obligation work in real-life situations, using 'must' for necessary rules, 'mustn't' for things that are forbidden, and 'don't have to' for things that are optional.
explanation.ru: Этот отрывок показывает, как модальные глаголы обязанности работают в реальных ситуациях, используя 'must' для необходимых правил, 'mustn't' для запрещенных вещей и 'don't have to' для необязательных вещей.
explanation.uz: Bu parcha majburiyat modal fe'llari real hayot vaziyatlarida qanday ishlashini ko'rsatadi, zarur qoidalar uchun 'must', taqiqlangan narsalar uchun 'mustn't' va ixtiyoriy narsalar uchun 'don't have to' ishlatiladi.

All visitors ___1___ follow these important rules to ensure patient safety and comfort. You ___2___ check in at the reception desk before going to any patient room. Visitors ___3___ show identification and they ___4___ wear visitor badges at all times while in the hospital.

For patient wellbeing, visitors ___5___ speak quietly in corridors and patient rooms. You ___6___ bring flowers or gifts if you want to, but you ___7___ bring food without checking with the nursing staff first, as some patients have special dietary requirements.

Regarding health safety, anyone who is feeling unwell ___8___ visit patients. You ___9___ come if you have a cold, fever, or any contagious illness. All visitors ___10___ wash their hands before entering patient rooms and again before leaving.

Visiting hours are clearly posted, and visitors ___11___ respect these times. Emergency visits are possible, but you ___12___ get special permission from the medical staff. Children under 12 ___13___ be accompanied by an adult at all times.

Mobile phones ___14___ be turned off or set to silent mode throughout the hospital. You ___15___ use phones in designated areas only, as they can interfere with medical equipment in some areas.
